today_tasks: 核对左栏英文对白原句：And I do hope you met a sacred Elephant. They're lint white I believe, and very, very sweet.
核对左栏英文对白原句：I've never loved anyone else for an instant. / No, no, you musn't—Elyot—stop.
核对左栏英文对白原句：You're looking very lovely you know, in this damned moonlight.
核对左栏英文对白原句：There isn't a particle of you that I don't know, remember, and want.
核对左栏英文对白原句：More than any desire anywhere, deep down in my deepest heart I want you back again—please—
核对左栏英文对白原句：Don't say any more, you're making me cry so dreadfully.
辨析右栏译文对“期待性”的评论：康格里夫与马里沃类似场景的“时期性”，1930 年感。
辨析右栏对 biscuit box（食盒）、lint white（丹麦）、damned moonlight（“可恶的 17 月月光”，passé）三个追溯日的提示。
辨析右栏对 particle（“分子/微粒”）在 20 世纪 40 年代晚期词义漂移的注释。
辨析右栏对 you're making me cry so dreadfully 中 dreadfully 的副词用法与 anywhere 的夸张义提示。
比对译注[1]“微粒”直译与译注[2]dreadfully = “严重地、可怕地”，对照左栏原文并记录疑义。
